_comment: One description of this standalone lesson build, read by every tool in ../lesson-app-tools/. Order here IS the teaching order and IS the unit number: unit N is lessons[N-1]. NOTE this build differs from grade-1-app and grade-2-app in one way that matters to any tool that patches a lesson: these .html files are GENERATED from src/ by src/build-all.sh, so a patch applied to them alone is discarded by the next rebuild. Wiring belongs in the fragments.
subject: mathematics
